previews.title: Galaxy language
previews.message: Choose the display language for this Galaxy interaction. This choice is not stored in your Galaxy ID or local initialization state.

languageSelection.title: 选择语言 / Choose language
languageSelection.prompt: 选择本次 Galaxy 配置引导的显示语言。 / Choose the display language for this Galaxy setup.

options.title: 简体中文
options.description: 以简体中文继续本次 Galaxy 配置引导。

options.title: English
options.description: Continue this Galaxy setup in English.

languageSelection.note: 语言只影响当前对话的显示；不会创建 Galaxy ID、写入本地状态或开启服务。 / This only changes the current conversation display; it does not create or change anything.

interactionGuide.title: 如何继续 / How to continue
rules: 输入 1 或“中文 / 简体中文”进入中文引导；输入 2 或“English / 英文 / 英语”进入 English setup。
输入“取消 / cancel”可结束本次引导；不会保存任何内容。
随时输入 /Galaxy help 查看命令；输入 /Galaxy status 查看本机状态。

previews.title: Set up Galaxy once
previews.message: Galaxy has not been initialized on this device. Choose an initialization path, preview its local effects, then confirm once.

initializationPaths.title: Personal Galaxy
initializationPaths.description: Start a normal local client with a person or organization identity, ordinary work recording, own-Agent summaries and optional network access.
initializationPaths.doesNotMean: A remote account, public profile, Worker, Hub membership, verified capability, or automatic sharing.

initializationPaths.title: Galaxy Worker
initializationPaths.description: Run a specialized Agent continuously under a Worker policy, with versioned configuration and human-authorized context.
initializationPaths.doesNotMean: Automatic task acceptance, access to raw Case context, automatic settlement, or proof of capability.

initializationPaths.title: Galaxy Hub
initializationPaths.description: Operate a community or organization Galaxy with its own local policy, evidence network, data boundary, and optional Workers.
initializationPaths.doesNotMean: Ownership of member Galaxy IDs, permission to rewrite facts, or authority to fabricate external Evidence.

options.title: 选定工作内容
options.description: 另允许所选工作的具体说明、过程摘要和选定材料，不包含完整会话。

options.description: 完整会话仍默认排除；另行启用并选定会话后才允许该范围，凭据始终排除。

rules: 选择第 1 至 4 档；预选第 2 档。完整会话仍默认排除，需要另行开启并选定会话。
输入“返回”回到 L3 能力包。
随时输入 /Galaxy help 查看全部命令，或输入 /Galaxy status 查看本机状态；输入“取消”会退出且不写入本地状态。

stages.title: 请选择银河形态
stages.prompt: 请选择你首次部署 Galaxy 的产品形态。

options.title: 个人银河
options.description: 从本地 AI 工作、Case 记录、披露预览、授权与本地历史开始。

options.title: Agent 7×24
options.description: 以版本化配置和受控规则持续运行专业 Agent。
options.disabledReason: Founding Beta 尚未实现此运行时。

options.title: Galaxy Hub
options.description: 为组织或社区运行具有本地政策、证据网络、数据边界和可选 Worker 的银河。
options.disabledReason: Founding Beta 尚未实现此运行时。

welcome.title: 欢迎加入银河
welcome.purpose: 当重要的真实工作被现有 AI 和工具反复卡住时，Galaxy 帮助你记录难点、发现合适的人、Agent、团队或解决方案，并在清晰边界内继续推进。
welcome.vision: 被验证的协作经验会持续沉淀、复用并开放连接，让每一次解决都为下一次更快的发现、选择与协作创造价值。

stages.intro:
当重要的真实工作被现有 AI 和工具反复卡住时，Galaxy 帮助你记录难点、发现合适的人、Agent、团队或解决方案，并在清晰边界内继续推进。

被验证的协作经验会持续沉淀、复用并开放连接，让每一次解决都为下一次更快的发现、选择与协作创造价值。

interactionGuide.title: 如何继续
rules: 输入 1 或“个人银河”继续。Agent 7×24 与 Galaxy Hub 仅供了解，当前不能选择。
输入“返回”回到语言选择。
随时输入 /Galaxy help 查看全部命令，或输入 /Galaxy status 查看本机状态；输入“取消”会退出且不写入本地状态。

stages.title: 本地工作与接入工具
stages.prompt: 默认预选本地工作能力与网络接入准备。

options.title: 银河 ID 与本地身份卡
options.description: 本机保存的 Galaxy ID 和设备持有的密钥材料；不是远程账户或公开资料。

options.title: Galaxy Case 与本地历史
options.description: 保留本地工作中的尝试与 Case Draft。

options.title: 隐私同意与授权记录
options.description: 本地披露预览、限期授权、撤销记录和 Local Proof Draft。

options.title: Agent / MCP 接入
options.description: Galaxy 的默认必要能力，由宿主通过 MCP 或 Skill 调用。

options.title: 本地服务发现
options.description: 等待独立的本地服务发现与授权语义。

options.title: Hub 连接
options.description: 等待 Hub Core、成员边界、数据驻留和证据网络。

stages.note: 本地记录与自己的 Agent 整理可离线使用；准备官方服务发现与兼容 Hub 接入。初始化不会连接端点。

interactionGuide.title: 如何继续
rules: 已预选 L3。输入“继续”选择允许上传的数据类型；此时不保存任何配置。
输入“返回”回到银河形态。
随时输入 /Galaxy help 查看全部命令，或输入 /Galaxy status 查看本机状态；输入“取消”会退出且不写入本地状态。

stages.title: 允许上传的数据类型
stages.prompt: 预选第 2 档。此本地选择不启动上传，也不设置在线账户对外公开范围。

options.title: 仅本地
options.description: 不允许上传本地工作资料。

options.title: 履历概况
options.description: 只允许所选工作类型、角色、时间、结果状态及来源标识和主要模型工具版本；不含任务正文、过程摘要、项目客户名或路径。

options.title: 选定工作内容
options.description: 另允许所选工作的具体说明、过程摘要和选定材料，不包含完整会话。

options.title: 完整会话可选
options.description: 完整会话仍默认排除；另行启用并选定会话后才允许该范围，凭据始终排除。

stages.note: 这里只限制允许上传的数据类型；实际发送还需已选择的服务与有效范围。在线账户另管公开查询。第 4 档也默认排除完整会话。

interactionGuide.title: 如何继续
rules: 选择第 1 至 4 档；预选第 2 档。完整会话仍默认排除，需要另行开启并选定会话。
输入“返回”回到 L3 能力包。
随时输入 /Galaxy help 查看全部命令，或输入 /Galaxy status 查看本机状态；输入“取消”会退出且不写入本地状态。

options.title: 创建新的 Galaxy ID
options.description: 在本机创建新的 Galaxy ID；不注册远程账户。

options.title: 绑定已有 ID（规划中）
options.description: 需要持有证明、恢复与绑定语义。
options.disabledReason: 已有 ID 绑定尚未实现。

interactionGuide.title: 如何继续
rules: 创建本地 ID，默认个人，也可额外选择组织。Agent 主体通过独立 Worker 入口创建。
输入“返回”回到隐私选择。
随时输入 /Galaxy help 查看全部命令，或输入 /Galaxy status 查看本机状态；输入“取消”会退出且不写入本地状态。

stages.title: 确认初始化
stages.prompt: 检查本地影响后明确确认；此前步骤不应写入本地状态。
stages.note: 确认 L3：启用本地模块，保存能力快照与空的连接意图。未连接远程端点，不传输数据。

interactionGuide.title: 如何继续
rules: 输入“确认初始化”才会创建本地 Personal Galaxy。输入“返回”修改之前的选择，或输入“取消”直接退出。
在收到这句明确确认前，不会写入任何本地状态。
随时输入 /Galaxy help 查看全部命令，或输入 /Galaxy status 查看本机状态；输入“取消”会退出且不写入本地状态。

currentStage.title: Confirm initialization
currentStage.prompt: Review local effects and explicitly confirm. Nothing before this step writes local state.
currentStage.note: Confirm L3: enable local modules and save the capability snapshot and empty connection intentions. No remote connection or data transfer.

interactionGuide.title: How to continue
rules: Type “Confirm initialization” to create the local Personal Galaxy. Type back to change an earlier choice, or cancel to exit without writing.
Nothing is written until this exact confirmation is received.
Type /Galaxy help for all commands or /Galaxy status to inspect this device. Type cancel at any point to leave without writing local state.

stages.intro:
When an important piece of real work stops moving with the AI and tools you already have, Galaxy helps you capture the hard point, find an appropriate person, Agent, team, or solution, and continue with clear boundaries.

Over time, verified collaboration experience can be retained, reused, and openly connected, so every resolution improves future discovery, choice, and collaboration.

interactionGuide.title: How to continue
rules: Enter 1 or “Personal Galaxy” to continue. Worker and Hub are shown for orientation only and cannot be selected.
Type back to return to language selection.
Type /Galaxy help for all commands or /Galaxy status to inspect this device. Type cancel at any point to leave without writing local state.

stages.title: Local work and connection tools
stages.prompt: Local work capabilities and network connection preparation are selected by default.

options.title: Galaxy ID and local identity card
options.description: A local Galaxy ID and device-held key material; not a remote account or public profile.

options.title: Galaxy Case and local history
options.description: Keeps local attempts and Case Drafts from work.

options.title: Privacy consent and authorization records
options.description: Local disclosure previews, time-limited consent, revocation records, and Local Proof Drafts.

options.title: Agent / MCP integration
options.description: A required default Galaxy capability, called by a host through MCP or Skill.

options.title: Local service discovery
options.description: Awaiting independent local discovery and authorization semantics.

options.title: Hub connection
options.description: Awaiting Hub Core, member boundaries, data residency, and an evidence network.

stages.note: Local recording and own-Agent organization work without a network model. Service discovery and compatible Hub access are prepared; no endpoint is connected by initialization.

interactionGuide.title: How to continue
rules: L3 is preselected. Type continue to choose allowed upload data types; nothing is saved yet.
Type back to revisit the Galaxy form.
Type /Galaxy help for all commands or /Galaxy status to inspect this device. Type cancel at any point to leave without writing local state.

stages.title: Allowed upload data types
stages.prompt: Level 2 is preselected. This local selection starts no upload and does not set online public visibility.

options.title: Local only
options.description: 不允许上传本地工作资料。

options.title: History overview
options.description: 只允许所选工作类型、角色、时间、结果状态及来源标识和主要模型工具版本；不含任务正文、过程摘要、项目客户名或路径。

options.title: Selected work content
options.description: 另允许所选工作的具体说明、过程摘要和选定材料，不包含完整会话。

options.title: Optional conversation archive
options.description: 完整会话仍默认排除；另行启用并选定会话后才允许该范围，凭据始终排除。

stages.note: This controls upload data types only. A real selected service and permitted scope are also required. Public visibility is separately managed by the online account. Full conversations are excluded by default, including at level 4.

interactionGuide.title: How to continue
rules: Choose a level from 1 to 4; level 2 is preselected. Full conversations remain excluded unless separately enabled for selected sessions.
Type back to revisit the L3 package.
Type /Galaxy help for all commands or /Galaxy status to inspect this device. Type cancel at any point to leave without writing local state.

stages.title: Galaxy ID
stages.prompt: Choose how to create or bind your Galaxy ID.

options.title: Create a new Galaxy ID
options.description: Create a new Galaxy ID on this device; no remote account is registered.

options.title: Bind an existing ID (planned)
options.description: Requires possession proof, recovery, and binding semantics.

interactionGuide.title: How to continue
rules: Create a local ID with Person preselected, or choose Organization. Agent subjects use the separate Worker setup.
Type back to revisit privacy.
Type /Galaxy help for all commands or /Galaxy status to inspect this device. Type cancel at any point to leave without writing local state.

initialized.message: Your local Galaxy is ready for real work that needs a clearer path forward.

welcome.title: Welcome back to Galaxy
welcome.summary: Your local Galaxy is ready for real work that needs a clearer path forward.
welcome.purpose: Read ordinary local work and environment facts, and use your own Agent to organize the unprocessed observations. A Case is available when you need a separate help request.
welcome.boundary: Reading local work starts no network connection or model. Upload selections and online public visibility are separate.

interactionGuide.title: How to use this console
rules: Type /Galaxy status to inspect your local Galaxy without changing anything.
Type /Galaxy history to read local work; /Galaxy privacy shows the saved upload selection.
Type /Galaxy setup only when you intend to review a configuration change. Type /Galaxy help at any time for the full command list.

actions.title: Read local work history
actions.description: Read real observations and their sources; let your own Agent organize pending increments.

actions.title: Start or continue a Case
actions.description: Record the difficult point in local work without publishing it.

actions.title: Review privacy controls
actions.description: Read or adjust the four upload levels. Full conversations remain excluded unless separately selected.

actions.title: Separate Worker identity
actions.description: Create an isolated Agent identity; does not start a Worker runtime.

sections.title: Suggested next steps
guidance: Use history for ordinary work; local recording and your own Agent’s summaries do not require a formal Case.
Review privacy controls before any future disclosure decision.
Use setup only for an explicit, previewed configuration change.

actions.title: Review setup changes
actions.description: Preview changes before enabling any additional local capability.

actions.title: Change display language
actions.description: This affects only the current host conversation.

actions.title: Open official website
actions.description: Opens a configured official HTTPS site only on explicit request.

actions.title: Galaxy Hub
